row.failure_or_unrun_reason: evidence collection not completed on this machine, so no committed run record exists. The OpenLane flow itself finished in 63.0 min (peak memory about 2 GiB in detailed routing): 41,989 standard cells, 314,206 um2 of cell area, die 623,274 um2 at 52.6 % utilization, DRC 0, LVS 0, setup slack +80.87 ns and hold slack +0.359 ns at the typical corners (fmax 52.3 MHz at tt, 26.8 MHz at the slowest ss corner), 117 residual antenna nets. The gate-level simulation of the final netlist matched the canonical frame (2055/2055 codes, block II 107, fill 99, source tail 205) but its activity window is a 2.2 GB VCD and the annotated-power step (OpenSTA, with the window read back as a VCD for the cross-check) used too much memory for this machine (WSL, 4 CPUs, 7.8 GiB) and had to be stopped. The run directory is kept in .build/ppa/F-serial/slow. The team's recommendation is requested in the T43 pull request.
